theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_iso_svol_volume_eq_of_slice_volume_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (S A : Set (Euclid d)), MeasurableSet S → MeasurableSet A → (∀ y : Euclid d, volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ S} = volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}) → volume S = volume A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
